about_short_description.short_description: Wearable technology to predict and prevent sepsis.

product.name: The Sepsis Scout System
product.description: A wearable device that monitors vital signs like heart rate, respiration rate, blood pressure, temperature, and SpO2 in real-time for high-risk patients. It sends data to a cloud-based deep learning algorithm for sepsis risk assessment.

product.name: The Sepsis Scout Algorithm
product.description: A deep learning algorithm that analyzes data from the wearable device, including micro-variations in vital signs and other physiological parameters, to predict the onset of sepsis well before its symptoms manifest.

product.name: Seamless Integration
product.description: The technology is designed to integrate into patients' daily lives unobtrusively, ensuring continuous monitoring without disrupting normal activities.
